task_description: Implement chat and terminal features in the adadex conversation tab: composer enhancements (Tab-to-queue, Escape×2 stop, Ctrl+Enter interrupt-and-send, Ctrl+G expanded, stash prompt, play button for pending), Chat/Terminal tab switching with Alt+G shortcut and model pill, and reading enhancements (per-message menu, text selection Reply, view modes, Cmd+F search focus).
